title: Sunset Orange and Honey Cream Palette Cards
whatItIs: A white palette panel titled Colors with six tall rounded cards: Sunset Orange, Burnt Orange, Honey Cream, Pure White, Light Ash and Graphite Black, each with a bold name at the top and hex and RGB values at the bottom, over a dimmed case-study page with a logo tile and Aa type specimens.
whatItMeans: Named swatches with both hex and RGB values are practical and warm, and orange with cream feels friendly.
techniques: Tall rounded swatch cards with names top-left
Hex and RGB values at the card base
Warm orange ramp from bright to burnt
Neutrals (white, ash, graphite) completing the set
Palette shown between logo and type sections

vocabulary.definition: A colour sample with a descriptive name.
A colour written as red, green and blue numbers.
White, grey and near-black colours supporting an accent.
